scriptsDescriptions.dev: Start Next.js dev server with hot reload on http://localhost:3000
scriptsDescriptions.build: Production build — runs TypeScript type-check, then emits `.next/`
scriptsDescriptions.start: Serve the production build (run `npm run build` first)
scriptsDescriptions.stop: Stop the dev server bound to the app port (default 3000; set PORT to override). Port-scoped — does not touch unrelated node processes
scriptsDescriptions.test: Vitest unit/component tests in watch mode
scriptsDescriptions.test:shuffle: Vitest at the SAME pinned seed as CI unit-tests-shuffled (BLOCKING) — reproduces an order-dependence failure locally
scriptsDescriptions.test:coverage: Vitest + v8 coverage report (BLOCKING floors: lines 92 / statements 89 / functions 91 / branches 80, plus per-engine globs in vitest.config.ts)
scriptsDescriptions.e2e: Playwright functional E2E (smoke + app nav + a11y), headless — the CI suite
scriptsDescriptions.e2e:smoke: Standalone smoke driver (scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs): seeds a project, walks every view, fails on any console/page error. Needs a running server
scriptsDescriptions.e2e:smoke:prod: Smoke against a real, already-built production server (scripts/e2e-smoke-prod.mjs): starts `next start`, runs the smoke, stops it. Does NOT build — run `npm run build` first. The ONLY local reproduction of the prod CSP; `e2e:smoke` alone only ever meets the permissive dev policy
scriptsDescriptions.e2e:visual: Playwright visual-regression snapshots (opt-in; baselines are per-platform — generate CI's in the Linux container)
scriptsDescriptions.e2e:visual:update: Regenerate visual snapshot baselines for the current platform
scriptsDescriptions.docs:scripts: Regenerate AUTO-GENERATED scripts tables in repo docs from `package.json`
scriptsDescriptions.docs:scripts:check: Verify AUTO-GENERATED scripts tables are in sync; exit non-zero on drift (CI mode)
scriptsDescriptions.dup:check: Duplication gate for `src/` via jscpd — BLOCKING in CI (total duplicated-line % vs --threshold)
scriptsDescriptions.size:check: Fail if a src file exceeds 800 lines or grows past its baselined size (ratchet)
scriptsDescriptions.docs:symbols:check: Fail if AGENTS.md or any docs/AGENTS/*.md names a code symbol that does not exist (nothing else gates them)
scriptsDescriptions.docs:claims:check: Fail if a doc gains a new `path:LINE` citation or cites a line that cannot exist (ratchet; prefer a symbol, a line number rots on any insertion above it)
scriptsDescriptions.followups:check: Report which claims in docs/open-followups.md a machine can still check — REPORTING ONLY, never blocking, and it rules claims OUT rather than IN (a CLEAN entry may still be stale)
